detailed_description: Tip Calculator makes it easy to calculate tips and split bills among multiple people. With preset tip percentages and custom options, you can quickly determine the tip amount, total bill, and per-person share. Perfect for dining out with friends or calculating service gratuities.
usage_steps: Select a tip percentage or enter a custom amount
Specify how many people are splitting the bill
View the tip amount and total
usage_examples: Determine appropriate tip amounts for different service levels
